content.text:
This confirms the root cause: several node subclasses call the `ZNode(ParentNode, SourceToken, Size)` constructor with `ParentNode = null` (e.g., `ZDefaultValueNode`, `ZSetNameNode`, `ZWhileNode`). After commit 800f8fb changed the constructor to `ParentNode.SetChild(this, ...)`, calling this with a null `ParentNode` would throw a `NullPointerException`, whereas the original `this.ParentNode = ParentNode;` safely handled null. The fix commit 274fe51 reverts exactly to the safe null-tolerant assignment.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 800f8fb7166942a90b20ffd2c70f5dae4763c9f8

## Reasoning
(1) I looked at the file history for `ZNode.java` and found the immediately preceding commit touching that same line, `800f8fb` ("[refactor] use Node.SetChild(Parent) instead of `Node.ParentNode = Parent;`"). Its diff is the exact inverse of the bug-fix diff in `274fe51` (same line, values swapped), which is a strong direct match.

(2) The refactor changed the `ZNode` constructor from `this.ParentNode = ParentNode;` to `ParentNode.SetChild(this, ZNode._EnforcedParent);`. `SetChild` is an instance method invoked *on* `ParentNode`, so if `ParentNode` is `null`, this call throws a `NullPointerException`. The original code (`this.ParentNode = ParentNode;`) tolerated a null parent just fine (root/parentless nodes get `ParentNode == null`).

(3) I found multiple subclasses that construct nodes via `super(null, ...)` (e.g., `ZBooleanNode`, `ZDefaultValueNode`, `ZSetNameNode`, `ZWhileNode`), i.e., nodes explicitly created with no parent. Any of these would NPE after the refactor in `800f8fb`, and the fix in `274fe51` restores the null-safe direct field assignment, exactly resolving that crash. This gives high confidence that `800f8fb` is the sole bug-introducing commit.
